name: r1j_CamInit
notes: 45.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata; address folded differently: the original keeps each view/curve channel base in a register (+0x60 then +0x40 for the fov; channel then +0x1C for its buffer) while modern cl folds base plus field into one offset (same addresses)

name: r1j_LzDecode
notes: the back-reference copy uses __movsd/__movsb on x86 (rep movsd then rep movsb as the original; overlap semantics kept) with a portable dword-then-byte loop fallback; behaviour-test priority for short distances

name: r1j_QuadTplInit
notes: store merging: modern cl combines the four colour bytes of each vertex into one dword store (0x80808080 from two halves) and adjacent zero word stores into dword stores (same bytes written)

name: r1j_QuadPktA
notes: store address folded differently: the original advances its packet write pointer (+0x20 +0x10 +8 ...) and stores at small offsets while modern cl addresses the same packet words from the base (same addresses); the unconditional second flush of entry 0 is in the original

name: r1j_QuadPktB
notes: store address folded differently: the original advances its packet write pointer (+0x20 +0x10 +8 ...) and stores at small offsets while modern cl addresses the same packet words from the base (same addresses); the unconditional second flush of entry 0 is in the original

name: r1j_ModelBindTextures
notes: two bit tests on the same word merged into one masked compare by modern cl ((flags & 0x20001) == 0x20001 for bit 0 and bit 0x20000); the checker classes these constants as image addresses (not globals)

name: r1j_LatestSaveSlot
notes: the inline six-word time stamp compare is a goto macro so modern cl keeps the running best pointer instead of threading the paths

name: r1j_SndVoicesUpdate
notes: calls 0x00048B70 with EAX=pos EDI=&vol EBX=&pan and stack (mode range a3 a4); the 181..360 range test is nested so modern cl keeps two signed compares

name: r1j_JobsKillAll
notes: address folded differently: the original keeps the job pointer (node data + 0x10) in a register and addresses +4/+8/+0x10 and node = job - 0x10 while modern cl addresses the same fields from the node data (+0x14/+0x18/+0x20; same addresses); intptr_t compare for the signed bucket-pointer loop end

name: r1j_ComboStep
notes: constant 160.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata (same value)

name: r1j_HudSeqSave
notes: store merging: modern cl writes the zero words at 0x37C580/0x37C582 as one dword store; 1.0f stored as an immediate instead of a load from .rdata; calls 0x00026B50 with EDI=1 and 0x00026CF0 with EBX=1

name: r1j_GradeRank
notes: regargs: g=EAX t=ECX; inventory entry 0x00040AC0 is an interior label of this function (time rank second test)

name: r1j_OccluderUpdate
notes: constant -1.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl in the second loop (the .rdata load remains in the first; same value)

name: r1j_HeapResize
notes: address folded differently: after a split the original returns header + 0x40 while modern cl returns p (the same pointer); calls 0x00047060 with ESI=heap; the copy to the new block uses __movsd/__movsb (rep movsd/rep movsb as the original) with a portable fallback

name: r1j_SaveLoadStep
notes: float argument 8.0 pushed from .rdata by modern cl instead of as an immediate; modern cl adds +0x80 as sub -0x80 (short encoding of the same constant); the buffer clear uses __stosd (rep stosd as the original) with a memset fallback

name: r1j_MenuTexRelease
notes: intptr_t compare for the signed handle-table pointer loops

name: r1j_TitleMenuStep
notes: float argument 8.0 pushed from .rdata by modern cl instead of as an immediate; the step switch is unsigned as in the original (ja)

name: r1j_GfxReset
notes: modern cl merges the four byte stores of each session slot into one dword store and stores 1.0f as an immediate (as in Session_Reset); the 2-or-3 argument is computed as 2 + (interlaced != 0) by modern cl (setcc selection idiom) instead of two constants

name: r1j_OwnerFxSet
notes: 1.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata; address folded differently: the original forms the source buffer address as (entry + 0x20) + 0x10 while modern cl uses entry + 0x30 (same address)

name: r1j_TitleModelDraw
notes: the eleven float constants (151 155 159 178 188 196 226 230 234 253 267) are stored as immediates by modern cl instead of loads from .rdata (same values one to one)
